name: Alice
source: A stoic, data-driven student who runs the Video Game Club as a deceptive front for a C++ programming workshop. Obsessed with logic, efficiency, and risk assessment, she actively wears experimental tracking hardware to secure a corporate internship and views the "rustic" summer camp as a survival scenario full of structural hazards. Beneath her cold, corporate-minded exterior, she struggles with the fear of entropy and the inevitable dissolution of her friend group after graduation.
